name: Choose Your Power
desc:
💿 Face off against other players using powerful Aspects!!! Unlock new powers by collecting Hits during battles or earning Badges through quests and achievements. There are currently 23 obtainable Aspects in the game.

🌐 All platforms/devices supported!!!!!!!!! 📱 🖥️ 🎮

🪼 Controls:
Click/Tap - Punch
Q, E, R - Use skills

♻️ Rules:
>>> No inappropriate earth builds
>>> No inappropriate avatars
>>> No tabbing/lag switching
>>> No exploits, macros or unfair fflags

🩵 Game by Blackcurrant, inspired by Strife Alpha and Ability Wars.
